name: The Ruins of Stardust
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness.  Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing.  But ... fever still rages within her.

Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust.  Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever.  Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.

The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, adventurer.  May Elune speed your journey.
narrative.objectives: Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You gathered the dust! I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.

Thank you again, adventurer. Without your help, my child would surely perish.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you yet have the Stardust, adventurer?
